statement: A mapping of SWBPIPE's committed contract corpus into App contract terms. It observes no SWBPIPE run, no App run and no person; no row establishes any human act.

swbpipe_would_need.NR-01: no attributable acceptance record per change (actor, act reference, capture time, capture evidence, bound content)
swbpipe_would_need.NR-02: no rejection record (A10); Clear discards without a record
swbpipe_would_need.NR-03: no per-change decision within a submission; agent proposals are applied as atomic batches
swbpipe_would_need.NR-05: no receipt reference on the outcome; the session receipt is UI state only and not durable
swbpipe_would_need.NR-06: basis on outcomes is the whole-model hash only: no model revision
swbpipe_would_need.NR-07: relied-on basis not carried: no claimed hash; per-field before-values are the only staleness guard
swbpipe_would_need.NR-08: no proposal record keyed by identity: no de-duplication before the basis check, no submission count, no observation by identity, no time
swbpipe_would_need.NR-09: no route for agent-originated proposals on main (offline file intake only; no live agent binding)
swbpipe_would_need.NR-10: no capability catalog: operation identity/version, declared errors, preconditions, class, exposure, edition
swbpipe_would_need.NR-11: an actor-dependent rule is a validation error on caller-asserted author_type, not a treatment on a verified actor

app_side.A-01: no App representation for an application at a person-initiated host Apply without an attributable act record
app_side.A-02: resulting_object.relation has no 'removed' for a deletion
app_side.A-03: no element for an application's persistence status (session only, not saved)
